controls.name: Restricted namespace enforcement
controls.description: Workload namespaces must declare restricted Pod Security enforcement.

controls.name: Required ownership labels
controls.description: Namespaces must identify their security owner and environment.

controls.name: Non-root workload execution
controls.description: Workload containers must run as a non-root user.

controls.name: Privilege escalation disabled
controls.description: Workload containers must disable privilege escalation.

controls.name: Linux capabilities reduced
controls.description: Workload containers must drop all Linux capabilities.

controls.name: Resource limits defined
controls.description: Workloads must define CPU and memory limits.

controls.name: Default-deny network policy
controls.description: Every workload namespace must have a default-deny ingress and egress policy.

controls.name: Least-privilege RBAC
controls.description: Read-only identities must not receive write or secret access.
